info.name: มาร์ท - ร้านค้า (สินค้า, ตะกร้า, คำสั่งซื้อ)
info.description: Run with the Collection Runner (Backend on {{baseUrl}}). Folder 0 logs in as the seeded member (somchai) and admin, so the seed data must be loaded. Folder 2 creates and deletes its own AT* product. Folder 4 CONFIRMS one real order for somchai and reduces that product's stock by 1 (re-seed the database to reset). Run the folders in order.
